name: whatsapp-community-mcp
description: Run WhatsApp groups with your own Green API instance (optional WhatsApp Cloud API): list groups, read recent messages, summarise activity (top posters, busiest hours, unanswered questions, links), draft announcements, and post or schedule messages. Every send needs explicit confirmation; per-user isolated storage.

GREEN_API_ID_INSTANCE.title: Green API instance ID
GREEN_API_ID_INSTANCE.description: Your own Green API idInstance. Needed to list groups, read messages and post.
